about_text:
I'm Lenny Winnemuller, based in Amsterdam. I started my career as a professional trader at an Amsterdam-based proprietary trading firm and later earned a seat at Peak Capital Trading. Today I invest independently for the long term and teach long-term investing in a Canadian trader education program. I graduated with honours in Psychology from the University of Amsterdam, specialising in emotion, performance and group behaviour.

I'm strongly grounded in probabilistic thinking, market behaviour and psychology. My philosophy: think rationally, form well-founded views about the future, and keep updating them as the evidence changes.
